name: Sapling
tagline: Sapling is an AI communication assistant that helps customer-facing teams write faster and more consistently. It provides real-time grammar and spelling suggestions, autocomplete for agent responses, and AI-generated reply drafts that integrate with helpdesk and CRM platforms.
